findings: Added two Mission counter actions: signed addition/subtraction and decimal digit replacement. Checked integer arithmetic rejects results outside 0..maximum; a fresh widget/event check precedes one call to the existing absolute setter. Normal mission events remain enabled.

Added read-only current Mission combo, retained peak and allowance in native update units. Peak is independent of the current maximum; finite negative allowance values remain visible. These are Mission widget fields, not Sora attack-combo parameters.

Expanded the offline BDX catalog from 239 to 256 annotations. Seventeen Gummi entries describe movement, strict-component selection, reaction impulses and controller vibration. All 1,063 numeric descriptors remain unchanged.

The selected Voice consumer clears a pending request before admission; failed admission does not automatically retry. A queued handle and EE state 2 do not establish audible playback. Backend identity uses a resource key, Voice ID and group, so a pool handle does not prove exclusive backend ownership.

Gummi movement attenuation uses a wrapping counter rather than a reference count. Equal components in the selected extent helpers can choose Z even when it is not the mathematical extreme. Duration and NaN boundaries remain explicit in the study and review.

The existing Final/Valor/Master second-weapon fallback is retained. It validates the form slot or a primary-weapon fallback, rechecks after Revert and rejects the new transformation if required resources are missing. No live-game confirmation is claimed.
